text: Onon ɓee yimɓe, kala ko luutondirɗon e fii mun ka doose diina maa ka calɗi mun, haray ñaawoore mun nden, ko ka Allah woni: on ruttoto ka Deftere Makko maa ka Sunna Nulaaɗo Makko on (yo o his). Ko On siforɗo ɗin sifaaji, woni Joomi am; ko e Makko mi fawi fii am on fow, ko ka Makko kadi mi ruttorta tuubugol.
